prompt: Mark the lines of this agency Upwork profile overview that should be rewritten.

task.prompt: Mark the lines of this agency Upwork profile overview that should be rewritten.

segments.text: Title: Web | Mobile | AI | Blockchain | Games | SEO | Design | Data Entry
segments.issue: A title listing everything signals no specialism and matches no search well.

segments.text: We help healthcare and logistics companies launch AI-powered web and mobile apps in 8-16 weeks.
Recent work: a patient-booking app for a clinic group and a route-planning dashboard for a courier firm.
We are the best and cheapest agency on Upwork.
segments.issue: Unprovable superlatives and 'cheapest' attract price shoppers and erode trust.

segments.text: Every project has a dedicated project manager and weekly demos.
Contact us for anything at all, we do it all.
segments.issue: Weak, unfocused close; invite a specific next step for the client's kind of project.

segments.text: Message us with your idea and we will reply with a rough plan within one business day.

prompt: Rank these portfolio items from most to least useful to feature on an agency profile that targets AI and mobile app buyers.

task.prompt: Rank these portfolio items from most to least useful to feature on an agency profile that targets AI and mobile app buyers.

items.label: A logo design done for a friend's cafe
An unlabelled screenshot of code with no context
Case study: AI support chatbot for an e-commerce brand, with screenshots, the problem, the solution and a measured result
Case study: React Native delivery app with screenshots and app store links

task.explanation: Outcome-led case studies in the target niche sell best; relevant work without outcomes is next; off-niche and context-free items add noise.

prompt: You rewrote the profile title and overview at the start of month 2. Calculate the invite rate (invites per 100 profile views) for each month and the percentage change.

task.prompt: You rewrote the profile title and overview at the start of month 2. Calculate the invite rate (invites per 100 profile views) for each month and the percentage change.
task.explanation: 8/800 x 100 = 1.0; 15/750 x 100 = 2.0; (2.0 - 1.0) / 1.0 = +100%. Fewer views but double the conversion.

prompt: Your agency profile gets views but few invites. The title is 'Full-Service Software Company'.

task.prompt: Your agency profile gets views but few invites. The title is 'Full-Service Software Company'.

steps.question: What is the best first change?
options: Lower the hourly rate
Remove all case studies to keep it short
Add more skills tags until the limit
Rewrite the title around a specific buyer and outcome, e.g. AI and mobile apps for healthcare startups
steps.explanation: The title drives both search match and the first impression; a specific buyer and outcome beats a generic label.

steps.question: Which change to the overview supports the new title best?
options: A list of every technology the team has used
The founding story and office photos
Two or three outcome-led case studies from that niche in the first lines
A long paragraph about company values
steps.explanation: Proof in the chosen niche makes the positioning credible.

prompt: A completed client left a 3-star review saying 'good code, poor communication'. Your profile has 20 other reviews averaging 4.9.

task.prompt: A completed client left a 3-star review saying 'good code, poor communication'. Your profile has 20 other reviews averaging 4.9.

steps.question: How should you respond on the profile?
options: Ignore it entirely
Post a short, professional reply that thanks them and names the process change made
Argue publicly that the client was unclear
Ask the client to delete it in exchange for a discount
steps.explanation: A calm reply showing what changed reassures future buyers more than silence or argument.

steps.question: What change best protects future reviews?
options: A fixed communication rhythm per project (weekly update and demo) owned by the PM
Only take short projects
Stop asking clients for reviews
Hide the review section
steps.explanation: The review named a process gap; fixing the process is what prevents repeats.

prompt: Rank these profile changes by likely impact on winning larger ($30k+) AI projects, highest first.

task.prompt: Rank these profile changes by likely impact on winning larger ($30k+) AI projects, highest first.

items.label: Add certifications in a cloud platform
Update the profile photo to the office building
Add two detailed AI case studies with business outcomes
Rewrite the title and overview to target a niche that buys larger projects

task.explanation: Proof of similar large work moves buyers most, then clear positioning; certifications help a little; photos barely matter.

prompt: Why is a niche-focused agency profile usually better than 'we do everything'?

options: Buyers search and decide by relevance, and a focused profile matches their problem and looks more expert
Upwork only allows one skill per profile
Niche profiles always charge lower rates
It removes the need for case studies
mcq.explanation: Specialism improves both search matching and perceived expertise.

options: We help logistics companies cut manual dispatch work with custom web and AI tools, live in 10-14 weeks.
Welcome to our profile! We are a team of passionate developers.
We are a software company established with many skilled resources.
Hire us for any IT work at the lowest price.
mcq.explanation: It names the buyer, the problem, the solution and a concrete expectation in one line.

prompt: Profile views are high but invites are low. What does that most likely point to?

options: Upwork is not showing the profile to anyone
The rate is too low
There are too many reviews
The profile is found in search but fails to convince: positioning, proof or the first lines need work
mcq.explanation: Views show discoverability is fine; low conversion points at what visitors see once they land.
